recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. Do not restore ChargeItem to source/fhir.ini or source/chargeitem for this issue; make any future ChargeItem.product changes in HL7/admin-incubator or the then-current owning repository.
issue_request: FHIR-14409 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification PA change request to add ChargeItem.product for charges depending on a specific delivered product instance, with the final resolution adopting the pre-applied content but changing it to CodeableReference.
initial_application: Legacy commit 370535c6c2924200b9b30c3a539f6456d334471c (git-svn build@13749) pre-applied the product element, and commit 659ea74c5598ec1a0c30d45951bf26eb03718886 changed source/chargeitem/structuredefinition-ChargeItem.xml to ChargeItem.product 0..* CodeableReference(Device|Medication|Substance). The v5.0.0 source tag contains the same final element.
additional_context: Current core source omits ChargeItem from source/fhir.ini, lacks source/chargeitem, and points ChargeItem to the HL7 Admin Incubator IG in ballot/module pages. Commit 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36 removed ChargeItem and ChargeItemDefinition from core. The Admin Incubator package currently contains StructureDefinition-ChargeItem with ChargeItem.product still 0..* CodeableReference(Device|Medication|Substance).
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No HL7/fhir source change was made because editing core would reintroduce or alter out-of-build ChargeItem source, while the requested product modeling is already present in the external current artifact.
